subject: [RFC PATCH 49/57] mm/khugepaged: drop the mmap_lock barrier from __khugepaged_exit()

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch removes a redundant barrier in the __khugepaged_exit() function, which was previously taking the mmap_lock for writing and dropping it to wait for a scan holding it for reading before destroying page tables. However, since the scan now holds a reference on mm_users until its completion, it cannot be in flight at this point, making the barrier unnecessary.
